text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容與期限以 BitoPro 官方公告為準。
text.en: Taken from the platform's share text; actual terms follow BitoPro's official announcements.

intro.zh-TW: BitoPro 加密貨幣交易所的邀請連結，使用邀請碼註冊。
intro.en: Referral link for the BitoPro crypto exchange. Sign up with the referral code.

description.zh-TW: BitoPro（幣託）是讓使用者交易加密貨幣的交易所。這個邀請連結已經包含邀請碼 8238042506；進入註冊頁後，若有推薦碼欄位而且是空的，請自行填入這組代碼。平台分享文案提到「180 天 20% 手續費折抵」，實際內容與期限以 BitoPro 官方公告為準。註冊前先確認網址列的網域與官方網站一致。
description.en:
BitoPro is a crypto exchange where users can trade crypto assets. The referral link on this page already contains the referral code 8238042506. Once the sign-up page opens, check whether it has a referral code field; if the field is empty, type the code in yourself.

The platform's share text mentions a 20% fee rebate for 180 days. Actual terms follow BitoPro's official announcements. Before you enter personal details, confirm that the domain in the address bar matches BitoPro's official website.
